mathematical concept.description: A defined mathematical term that is not a distribution family, construction or parameter: the gamma function, the standard score, the moment generating function. Examples: the gamma function; the standard score.

distribution family.description: A named family of probability distributions, possibly with parameters: the normal distribution, the gamma distribution, the standard normal distribution. Mentions include adjectival forms ("normally distributed", "has a gamma distribution"). Examples: the normal distribution; lognormal distribution; normally distributed.

family construction.description: A way of generating a family of distributions from a base distribution, such as the location-scale family, the location family or the scale family associated with a distribution, or the general exponential family. Not itself a single distribution family. Examples: location-scale family; scale family associated with the given distribution.

distribution parameter.description: A parameter of a distribution family or construction, such as the location parameter, the scale parameter, the shape parameter k, the rate, the mean or the standard deviation when these parameterize the family. Examples: location parameter; shape parameter k; the rate parameter.

random variable.description: A random variable denoted by a symbol (X, Y, Z, X_1, W) or by an expression in other random variables (a + b X, e^Y, X_1 + X_2). Local to the statement or section that introduces it. Examples: X; a + b X; X_1 + X_2.

head: random variable
has distribution.description: The random variable has a distribution in the family, optionally with stated parameter values. "X is normally distributed with mean μ and variance σ²".

head: distribution family
family construction
has parameter.description: A family or construction has this parameter. "with shape parameter k and scale parameter b".
